outlier.rule: Tukey IQR fences on the paired differences: a value outside [Q1 - 1.5*IQR, Q3 + 1.5*IQR] is flagged; a value outside [Q1 - 3.0*IQR, Q3 + 3.0*IQR] is extreme. Quartiles use linear interpolation (type-7) on the sorted differences. Flags never drop points from the headline estimate; they feed trimmed_sensitivity() only. Raw evidence is always retained.
